page_title: LEV 2-2 HOL | Bayer Leverkusen v Holstein Kiel 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90+7' An attempted cross from Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared.
90+6' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+4' Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+3' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Timon Weiner intercepts the ball.
90+1' It's like he was asking for a caution. Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) receives a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just inches over the bar.
90' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' None of the Bayer Leverkusen players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

88' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Now Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
88' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
86' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged for offside.
86' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
86' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' Marcel Rapp prepares a substitution. Lewis Holtby is replaced by Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel).
86' It's time for a substitution. Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) comes on in place of Finn Porath.

85' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
82' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
81' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
81' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
79' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
78' The free kick finds Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just over the bar from close range.
77' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Jeremie Frimpong.
74' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Holstein Kiel.
73' Lukas Hradecky makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) after a cross from the side.
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) for Armin Gigovic.
70' It will be a substitution. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to enter the pitch as Victor Boniface walks off.
70' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Exequiel Palacios and he is replaced by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Robert Andrich.
69' 2 - 2 Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) steps up and confidently powers his spot-kick into the bottom right corner.
69' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
68' Today's referee Robert Hartmann rightly decides to book Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) for his harsh tackle.
68' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle after Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Holstein Kiel.
68' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
67' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) plays a through ball but overhits it.
67' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
64' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.
64' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
63' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
60' Substitution. Jonas Hofmann will be replaced by Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen).
60' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
59' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and sends his close-range header well past the right post.
58' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen get a free kick.
57' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.
54' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
50' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Timon Weiner scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
46' Half-time substitution. Marcel Rapp decided to make a change. Steven Skrzybski is replaced by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel).
46' Half-time substitution. Shuto Machino will not participate anymore and Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) is coming on.
46' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' 2 - 1 Gooal! Lewis Holtby takes over corner duties. Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 2:1.
45+5' Holstein Kiel have a corner.
45+4' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block.
45+4' Holstein Kiel take a short corner kick.
45+4' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Lukas Hradecky.
45+3' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
44' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
41' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
40' The game is interrupted now, Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
37' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
35' 63:37 – the ratio of ball possession.
31' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) dribbles into the box, but Timon Weiner is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
28' The goal by Bayer Leverkusen is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
27' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bayer Leverkusen players aren’t happy.

26' GOAL! Superb work from Granit Xhaka, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), who beats Timon Weiner with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
23' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
23' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
21' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the right post.
21' The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
20' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Timon Weiner stops the ball from going inside right post.
19' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

18' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Timon Weiner was alert and the score remains the same.
17' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.
17' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
14' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
10' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
10' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Bayer Leverkusen.

8' 2 - 0 Goal! Exequiel Palacios displays great vision and sends a pass to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 2:0.
8' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Timon Weiner.
7' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

7' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the top of the net. His effort is blocked by Timon Weiner with a brilliant diving save!

4' 1 - 0 Goal! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short pass from Exequiel Palacios in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
3' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Holstein Kiel will kick-off.
Robert Hartmann is the one to supervise the game today.
